integrity: Exact finite-state rational checks accompany a written analytic all-size proof. Broad power-spectral edge decompositions and hidden-transition dominance are credited to earlier sources. Bibliographic completeness has not been independently established.
scientific_limitations: Finite homogeneous stationary symmetric exclusion on a periodic cycle, a single contiguous observation block, and the martingale-corrector decomposition of zero-frequency integrated-occupation variance only. Does not characterize finite-time sample-path approximations or other lattices.
title: Sharp boundary-noise deficit for equilibrium exclusion on a cycle
